hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); COMMAND=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -q 'worktree'; then echo '--- Worktree Validation ---'; git worktree list; LATEST=$(git worktree list | tail -1); echo "Confirmed: Worktree operation completed. Latest worktree: $LATEST"; fi

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$FILE" in */hop-ui/*) cd "${FILE%%/hop-ui/*}/hop-ui" ;; esac; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css) npx prettier --write "$FILE" || echo "prettier failed for $FILE" ;; esac; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx eslint --fix "$FILE" || echo "eslint failed for $FILE" ;; esac; case "$FILE" in *.py) (cd "${FILE%%/hop-sowa/*}/hop-sowa" 2>/dev/null && uv run ruff format "$FILE" 2>/dev/null && uv run ruff check --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null) || echo "ruff failed for $FILE" ;; esac; true
